text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Mom and Dad! It's Yukino. The date 
for my debut in the Twinkle Series has 
been set!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Regional Umamusume are all the rage over 
here! Just 'cause I'm from Morioka, they 
even went and started a fan club for me!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Even though they say that, it's just 
'cause of my vibe, or my accent bein' 
unusual... Seems like a lot of folks in my 
fan club haven't actually ever watched a 
race."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Still, Mifuyu-chan (no introduction 
needed! My bestie and future figure 
skating queen) told me: 'A craze is a 
chance.' As long as I get results, it'll 
all work out!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"I'll give it my all to become a sparkling 
'City Girl'! I'll write letters back home 
to the village too, so please cheer me on 
together!"
